The `prism-fsharp.min.js` file is the minified version of the same script and would also require updating to reflect any changes made in `prism-fsharp.js`.
1.bug_scenario: The bug pertains to the F# syntax highlighting in Prism.js. The issue arises because, in F#, it is common to convert the multiplier operator to a function using `(*)`. However, the F# syntax highlighter mistakenly treats `(*... ..*)` as a multi-line comment, which is not the intended behavior when using `(*)` as a function. This results in incorrect highlighting of F# code that utilizes the `(*)` function, as demonstrated in the provided example code snippet and the linked screenshot.
